description.value: Cariboo Chilcotin Jetboat Adventures is a locally owned and operated river tour company based out of Williams Lake, offering fully guided jetboat tours on the Fraser River through dramatic canyons and wilderness. Tours highlight the world's largest non-migratory bighorn sheep herd, First Nations cultural sites including 8,000-year-old petroglyphs, gold rush history, and abundant wildlife. The company has operated for over 25 years and holds multiple tourism awards including Cultural Tourism Business of the Year, making it a notable stop for cyclists exploring the Cariboo Chilcotin region.

enrichment_extras.reasoning: The website is fully accessible and confirms the business is an active jetboat tour operator based in Williams Lake/Riske Creek, BC, operating on the Fraser River. No OSM tags are present beyond the name and URL, so all enrichment comes from website content. The website makes no mention of bike parking, washrooms, water refill, or any cyclist-specific amenities — all such fields default to null per evidence rules.
concerns: OSM record has no address or phone tags; address and phone taken from website only. OSM lat/lon (51.983, -122.276) places the business near Williams Lake, but the mailing address is Riske Creek — likely a PO box for a tour operation that launches from the river, not a discrepancy requiring exclusion.
enrichment_extras.recommended_status_reason: Real, active, publicly accessible tourism business operating on the Fraser River with a live website, confirmed contact details, and an active tour season — a legitimate attraction for cyclists touring the Cariboo Chilcotin region.
enrichment_extras.notes: The website mentions tours are accessible as part of a BC road trip and via BC Ferries Discovery Coast Package, suggesting the operator is accustomed to touring visitors. Lunch is provided on the 8-hour safari tour (eaten along the Fraser River), but this is part of the guided tour package, not a public café on site.
